_about: Per-exercise coaching extras for the app. Keyed by backend/data/exercises.json id. See AGENTS.md > Add an exercise. setupCue (≤ 8 words) and focusCue (≤ 6 words) are what the Live coach says in the briefing — spoken-friendly, no symbols.

curlup.helps: Builds front-core endurance without bending the spine under load.
curlup.postureFix: A braced, rib-down trunk that stops the pelvis dumping forward into tilt.
curlup.gotIt: Hold 8s with head/neck/shoulders lifted as one unit, natural low-back curve preserved on your hands, breathing through pursed lips.

birddog.helps: Trains the back and glutes to hold the spine still while limbs move.
birddog.muscles: Gluteus maximus, spinal extensors (isometric), obliques, transverse abdominis
birddog.postureFix: A pelvis that stays level in walking and lifting instead of tipping forward.
birddog.gotIt: Hold 8s per side with the pelvis level (the imagined glass of water stays on your low back) and the leg reaching long, not high.
birddog.setupCue: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips

sideplank.helps: Builds the side-core endurance that is your known lateral gap.
sideplank.postureFix: A pelvis that does not drop or roll sideways in single-leg stance and gait.
sideplank.gotIt: Hold 30s per side in one straight line from head to knees, hips stacked, breathing steadily — stop at form loss, not shaking failure.

deadbug.helps: Teaches the core to hold a tucked, rib-down pelvis while the legs move — the anti-tilt skill.
deadbug.postureFix: Posterior-tilt control on demand, so standing stops defaulting to an arched stance.
deadbug.gotIt: A full set with the low back staying heavy on the floor for every rep — the moment it arches off, the rep does not count.
deadbug.bandTarget: Light long band anchored overhead; if the back arches, drop the band and do toe taps
deadbug.setupCue: On your back, arms up, knees at ninety

pallof.helps: Anti-rotation strength — the trunk refuses to be twisted by everyday loads.
pallof.muscles: Obliques, transverse abdominis, gluteus medius (stance side)
pallof.postureFix: Ribs stacked over the pelvis under load instead of flaring and tipping.
pallof.gotIt: 10 presses per side with ribs down, hips square, and zero torso rotation as the arms extend.
pallof.bandTarget: Light-to-medium long band at chest height — the last 2 reps are work, the torso never rotates

breathing360.helps: Restores diaphragmatic breathing and the brace every other exercise depends on.
breathing360.muscles: Diaphragm, transverse abdominis, pelvic floor, obliques
breathing360.postureFix: Ribs that drop down-and-in on the exhale instead of flaring up into tilt.
breathing360.gotIt: 6 breaths where your hands on the lower ribs move out sideways and back — not up — and each exhale ends in a gentle brace, ribs down.

pelvictilt.helps: Teaches the posterior tilt itself — the exact movement tilt correction is built on.
pelvictilt.postureFix: Voluntary control of pelvic position — the prerequisite for the hip-flexor stretch and dead bug.
pelvictilt.gotIt: Hold 3s per rep with the waistband visibly tipping up using abs + glutes, pain-free, breathing throughout.

hipflexorstretch.helps: Lengthens the tight hip flexors that pull the pelvis into anterior tilt.
hipflexorstretch.muscles: Iliopsoas, rectus femoris (stretched); gluteus maximus of the back leg (active)
hipflexorstretch.postureFix: The direct counter to anterior tilt — the pelvis can sit neutral instead of being dragged forward.
hipflexorstretch.gotIt: Hold 45s per side feeling the stretch in the FRONT of the hip, tailbone tucked, no low-back arch — if you feel it in your back, you are arching, not stretching.
hipflexorstretch.setupCue: Half-kneeling, back knee on a cushion

glutebridge.helps: Wakes up the glute max that tilt and sitting switch off.
glutebridge.muscles: Gluteus maximus, gluteus medius (band), hamstrings (assist only)
glutebridge.postureFix: Glutes strong enough to hold the pelvis tucked in standing, not just on the floor.
glutebridge.gotIt: Top of every rep held 2s with ribs down, knees pushing out into the band, squeeze from the glutes — never an arch to finish.
glutebridge.bandTarget: Light-to-medium loop band above the knees — knees stay out for all 20 reps
glutebridge.setupCue: On your back, band above knees

clamshell.helps: Builds glute med, the pelvic-stability muscle weak in the guarding pattern.
clamshell.muscles: Gluteus medius, deep hip external rotators
clamshell.postureFix: A pelvis that stays level in single-leg support instead of dropping toward the weak side.
clamshell.gotIt: A full set felt deep in the buttock, pelvis not rolling back, feet glued — front-of-hip feel means TFL took over: reduce range.
clamshell.bandTarget: Light loop band above the knees; no band until the deep-buttock feel is reliable
clamshell.setupCue: Lie on your side, band above knees

pullapart.helps: Strengthens the upper-back muscles sitting switches off.
pullapart.postureFix: Shoulder blades that sit down-and-together by default, undoing rounded shoulders.
pullapart.gotIt: 15 reps with the band touching the chest, blades pinching, ribs down, no low-back arch, 2-second return.
pullapart.bandTarget: Light long band — full range to the chest for all 15 reps with no shrug
pullapart.setupCue: Arms straight, band at chest height

facepull.helps: Trains external rotation + upper back together — the full upper-crossed antidote.
facepull.muscles: Infraspinatus/teres minor, rhomboids, middle trapezius, posterior deltoid
facepull.postureFix: Shoulders that rotate open and sit back instead of rolling forward and in.
facepull.gotIt: Finish position held with knuckles back, thumbs behind you, elbows high, neck long, chin tucked — for all 15 reps.
facepull.bandTarget: Light long band anchored at face height — rotation must complete on every rep
facepull.setupCue: Band at head height, elbows high

row.helps: Builds the mid-back pulling strength that holds the chest tall.
row.muscles: Rhomboids, middle trapezius, latissimus dorsi, posterior deltoid
row.postureFix: A tall chest and retracted shoulder blades that persist through the workday.
row.gotIt: 12 reps pulled to the lower ribs, spine neutral, blades gliding together, ribs down at the finish.
row.bandTarget: Medium long band — last 2 reps effortful, spine never rounds

chintuck.helps: Wakes up the deep neck flexors and glides the head back over the shoulders.
chintuck.postureFix: Head stacked over the shoulders instead of jutting forward of them.
chintuck.gotIt: Hold 5s per rep with a straight-back glide (double chin made), eyes level, no downward tilt — 10 clean reps.
chintuck.setupCue: Sit or stand tall, eyes level

deepneckflexor.helps: Builds endurance in the deep neck flexors so the chin tuck holds all day.
deepneckflexor.postureFix: Forward-head correction that lasts — endurance, not just mobility.
deepneckflexor.gotIt: Hold 10s with the tuck kept the whole time, head barely off the floor, breathing normally, front-of-neck staying quiet.
deepneckflexor.setupCue: On your back, small chin tuck

wallangel.helps: Combines thoracic mobility with lower-trap control against a wall that gives honest feedback.
wallangel.muscles: Lower/middle trapezius, serratus anterior; thoracic extensors (mobility)
wallangel.postureFix: Arms can reach overhead without ribs flaring and the low back arching off the wall.
wallangel.gotIt: 10 reps with head, upper back and tailbone all staying on the wall, ribs down for the whole slide.
wallangel.setupCue: Back against the wall, feet forward

wallslide.helps: Teaches the shoulder blades to slide up-and-around without shrugging.
wallslide.postureFix: Upward scapular rotation with a long neck, replacing the shrug-and-round pattern.
wallslide.gotIt: 10 slides in a narrow V, forearms staying on the wall, ribs down, neck long, no ear-shrug at the top.

doorwaychest.helps: Opens the tight pecs that pull the shoulders forward.
doorwaychest.postureFix: Removes the front-side tightness so the upper-back work can hold the shoulders back.
doorwaychest.gotIt: Hold 30s per side with the stretch in the front of the chest, chin lightly tucked, ribs down, zero low-back arch.

hipir9090.helps: Restores hip rotation so the lumbar spine stops compensating for a stiff right hip.
hipir9090.muscles: Hip internal/external rotators, gluteus medius, adductors
hipir9090.postureFix: A right hip that rotates inward in gait, ending the left-side weight-shift guarding.
hipir9090.gotIt: 8 slow switches sitting tall, both knees reaching the floor on both sides — the stiff right side is the measure; leaning away does not count.
hipir9090.setupCue: Sit tall, both knees at ninety

seatedhipir.helps: Strengthens right hip IR in a chair — the desk-friendly version of the IR program.
seatedhipir.muscles: Hip internal rotators (adductor group, gluteus medius anterior fibres)
seatedhipir.postureFix: Active IR strength, not just passive range, on the side that guards.
seatedhipir.gotIt: 12 reps per side with the thigh pinned still and trunk tall — rotation from the hip only; right side first, plus an extra set.
seatedhipir.bandTarget: Light loop band around the ankles — full set without the thigh swinging
seatedhipir.setupCue: Sit tall, band around the ankles

sidesteps.helps: Builds glute med endurance for level-pelvis walking.
sidesteps.postureFix: A pelvis that stays level step after step instead of dipping toward the weak side.
sidesteps.gotIt: A full set at one height — no bouncing — knees out, band tight on every step.
sidesteps.bandTarget: Light loop band above the knees; band at ankles is the progression

proneir.helps: Measures and mobilises prone hip internal rotation — your known right-side deficit.
proneir.postureFix: Inward rotation restored at the hip so the lumbar spine stops rotating in its place.
proneir.gotIt: Foot drops outward with the pelvis glued to the floor — compare sides honestly; the smaller side is the work.

adductorsqueeze.helps: Teaches the inward rotators to work with the 90/90 pattern.
adductorsqueeze.postureFix: Inward-rotation strength to pair with the mobility work.
adductorsqueeze.gotIt: 10 squeezes at 70% effort, 5-sec holds, breathing out on each squeeze.

hiphinge.helps: Grooves the hip hinge — load through the hips, spine neutral.
hiphinge.postureFix: A hinge that replaces lumbar flexion in every daily bend and lift.
hiphinge.gotIt: All three dowel contacts — head, mid-back, tailbone — held for every rep; stop where contact breaks.
hiphinge.setupCue: Dowel on head, mid-back and tailbone

pullthrough.helps: Hinge power from the glutes with a band — the deadlift pattern, spine-sparing.
pullthrough.postureFix: Glutes finishing the hip extension so the low back never arches to finish a rep.
pullthrough.gotIt: 15 reps snapped upright by the glutes, ribs down at the top — squeeze, never arch.
pullthrough.setupCue: Face away from the band, hinge back

singlebridge.helps: Single-leg glute strength with pelvic control — the guarding corrector.
singlebridge.postureFix: Both sides trusted equally in single-leg support; the avoided side relearns load.
singlebridge.gotIt: 12 reps per side with the pelvis level — no drop or rotation on the free side.
singlebridge.setupCue: On your back, one foot planted

qlreach.helps: Gentle QL mobility — the side that guards and shortens.
qlreach.postureFix: Side-to-side ease so one stiff side stops steering the trunk.
qlreach.gotIt: Small, smooth range with easy breathing — stop if anything refers down the leg. Gentle and unloaded, always.

kneechest.helps: Gentle flexion relief for a stiff, achy low back — one knee only, always.
kneechest.postureFix: A relief position that settles morning stiffness without stressing the disc.
kneechest.gotIt: 8 alternating reps, 20-sec gentle holds, mild stretch only — never both knees together.

figure4.helps: Releases the piriformis/deep rotators that crowd the sciatic nerve.
figure4.postureFix: Hip external rotation ease that pairs with the IR program.
figure4.gotIt: 30 sec per side felt in the buttock, not the knee, softening with the breath.
figure4.setupCue: On your back, ankle over knee

catcamel.helps: Gentle segmental motion that reduces spinal stiffness before stability work.
catcamel.postureFix: A spine that moves segment by segment instead of hinging at one sore level.
catcamel.gotIt: 5–6 slow cycles through a comfortable arc — motion, not stretch; no end-range pushing.

wallsquat.helps: Supported squat pattern while leg strength rebuilds.
wallsquat.postureFix: Knees tracking over toes with a supported, neutral spine.
wallsquat.gotIt: 12 reps with knees tracking over the toes, heels down, only as deep as symptoms allow.
wallsquat.setupCue: Back to the wall, feet forward

march9090.helps: Banded hip control — marching with a level pelvis (Christina Nicci: control before load).
march9090.muscles: Gluteus medius, hip rotators, deep core
march9090.postureFix: Pelvic control in the gait pattern itself.
march9090.gotIt: 8 slow steps per side, pelvis level, 3 seconds per step — no trunk lean to lift the leg.
march9090.bandTarget: Light loop band above the knees
march9090.setupCue: On your back, band above knees

new-seated-pelvic-tilt.helps: Resets anterior tilt while seated — the position the tilt is worst in.
new-seated-pelvic-tilt.postureFix: A seated pelvis that can find neutral instead of slumping then arching.
new-seated-pelvic-tilt.gotIt: Hold 3s with the waistband tipped up, ribs stacked over the pelvis, feet flat, no breath-hold.
new-seated-pelvic-tilt.setupCue: Sit on your sit-bones, feet flat

new-seated-scap-pinch.helps: No-band substitute for pull-aparts during the workday.
new-seated-scap-pinch.postureFix: Shoulder blades re-set down-and-together after every hour of screen slouch.
new-seated-scap-pinch.gotIt: Hold 3s with blades pinched and slid down toward the back pockets, chest tall, no arch, no shrug.

new-standing-wall-reset.helps: A full-stack posture check — head, ribs, pelvis — against a wall’s honest feedback.
new-standing-wall-reset.muscles: Deep cervical flexors, lower trapezius, deep abdominals (isometric)
new-standing-wall-reset.postureFix: Re-teaches the stacked standing posture that tilt + forward head erase.
new-standing-wall-reset.gotIt: Hold 20s with tailbone, upper back and back of head all on the wall, chin tucked, ribs down, breathing normally.
new-standing-wall-reset.setupCue: Tailbone, blades and head on the wall

new-seated-thoracic-opener.helps: Mobilises the stiff upper back (T4–T7) over the chair back — thoracic only, lumbar stays still.
new-seated-thoracic-opener.muscles: Thoracic extensors (mobility), deep neck flexors (head support)
new-seated-thoracic-opener.postureFix: Upper-back extension restored so the neck stops compensating for a rounded thorax.
new-seated-thoracic-opener.gotIt: 6 reps arching only over the chair-back edge at mid-back level, hands supporting the head, pelvis glued to the seat.

new-standing-glute-tilt.helps: The standing version of the tilt fix — glutes on, pelvis tucked, while the coffee brews.
new-standing-glute-tilt.postureFix: Standing posture with the pelvis tucked by glutes instead of hanging on the hip flexors and low back.
new-standing-glute-tilt.gotIt: Hold 5s standing tall, glutes squeezed, belt buckle tipped up toward the ribs, knees soft, breathing normally.

new-seated-desk-hip-ir.helps: The work-clothes version of the right-hip IR program — no band, no floor.
new-seated-desk-hip-ir.postureFix: Keeps right IR range from stiffening back up across a desk day.
new-seated-desk-hip-ir.gotIt: 10 reps with the thigh still, trunk tall, shin rotating out from the hip only — no trunk lean.

new-chair-sit-stand.helps: Glute strength in the exact pattern of getting out of a chair — done 50× a day.
new-chair-sit-stand.postureFix: Rising with glutes and a neutral spine instead of rounding then arching the low back.
new-chair-sit-stand.gotIt: 8 reps standing fully tall, glutes squeezed, pelvis tucked at the top, knees tracking over toes, no hand push-off.
new-chair-sit-stand.setupCue: Feet flat, sit near the edge

new-standing-chest-opener.helps: Doorway-stretch substitute for hotel rooms and offices with no free door frame.
new-standing-chest-opener.postureFix: Opens the chest anywhere, so rounded shoulders do not set in during travel days.
new-standing-chest-opener.gotIt: Hold 20s, hands clasped behind the back, arms gently straightening, chest open, chin tucked, ribs down.

standinghipir.setupCue: Side-on to a chair, band at the ankle

rectusstretch.setupCue: Hold a chair, hold your ankle

kickback.setupCue: Band at the ankles, hold a chair

suitcasecarry.setupCue: Weight in one hand, stand tall

proneext.setupCue: Face down, arms at your sides

hamstring9090.setupCue: On your back, hold behind the thigh

constructiverest.setupCue: On your back, calves on a chair
